# 跨越多个模块的长标题会自然换行\n\n阅读正文使用 14px 字号与 22p:
# A long heading across multiple modules wraps naturally

Body text uses a 14px font and 22px line height.

## Architecture

Expose tools through **MCP**.

### Core module

- Persistence
- Authorization

#### Connection

Connection status affects local operations.

##### Request

Requests use the shared protocol.

###### Response

Preserve original results.

| Module | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Core | Persistence and authorization |
默认重阴影，悬停轻微浮起；按下回落并减弱阴影。: Heavy shadow by default. Lift slightly on hover; settle and reduce the shadow when pressed.
当前黄圆、已执行绿圆、失败红圆；运行中黄圈内环旋转，减少动态效果时静止。: Amber for current, green for completed, red for failed. The inner ring rotates while running and stays still with reduced motion.
标题栏与正文同背景，输出填满剩余高度；上滚暂停跟随，追加日志后可回到最新。: Title bar shares the body background. Output fills remaining height; scrolling up pauses follow, and Jump to latest restores it after logs append.
预览：任务结束后关闭窗口。: Preview: Close the window after the task ends.
加载保留宽度并阻止重复提交，禁用取消交互效果。: Loading preserves width and prevents duplicate submissions. Disabled controls have no interactive effects.
鼠标点击只显示选中边框；Tab 导航保留焦点，选中且聚焦时用光晕区分。: Mouse clicks show only the selected border. Tab navigation retains focus; selected and focused options use a glow.
鼠标选择、键盘焦点使用同一边界，边框不叠加；选中且聚焦时增加光晕。: Mouse selection and keyboard focus share one boundary without overlapping borders. Selected and focused cards add a glow.
选中项无线框，左侧竖线向右投射柔边光束；浅色模式使用琥珀图标与通透金橙灯光，点击: Selected items have no border, with a soft beam cast from the left indicator. Light mode uses amber icons and golden-orange light; hit areas remain 44px.
默认灰色轮廓；悬停或键盘聚焦显示对应颜色与完整底部光晕。: Gray outline by default. Hover or keyboard focus shows the corresponding color and full bottom glow.
与 Tab 共用选中效果；支持方向键、Home 和 End，跳过禁用项。: Shares selection styling with Tabs. Supports arrow keys, Home, and End, skipping disabled items.
名称用于识别配置。留空保存可体验校验反馈。: The name identifies this configuration. Save it empty to try validation feedback.

请使用 Lumi 官方 HTML/CSS/JavaScript 模板，为我开发个:
Use the official Lumi HTML/CSS/JavaScript template to build my personal workbench. The user should not need to install Node or run a build.

1. Call Lumi.get_context to verify the version and real capabilities, then Lumi.get_workbench to read existing source and version.
2. For an existing HTML homepage, continue editing sourceFiles and retain projectId. Initially call Lumi.get_workbench_template or Lumi.export_workbench_project to get the current static template, SDK, and knowledge.
3. Read LUMI_DEVELOPMENT.md and knowledge. Freely develop root index.html, app.js, and style.css for my goals. Other offline assets or static framework output may be added. Preserve the fixed entry points and SDK protocol.
4. Use Lumi through window.lumi context/capabilities/tools/storage/theme/toast. Use real tools/list schemas for tool parameters.
5. Construct manifest/files/sourceFiles JSON and call Lumi.publish_workbench with the expectedVersion read at the start. Use Lumi.export_workbench_project, Lumi.list_workbench_versions, and Lumi.restore_workbench_version for export, history, and restoration. Do not require Node installation. On a conflict, retrieve the latest source and merge.
6. Verify real loading and interactions in Lumi. Simulation is not proof of real execution; explain when a Runner is unavailable. Preserve keyboard access, themes, reduced motion, and narrow-window support.
请使用 Lumi 官方 HTML/CSS/JavaScript 模板，为我自由开:
Use the official Lumi HTML/CSS/JavaScript template to freely develop a homepage for my common workflows.

1. Call Lumi.get_context and Lumi.get_workbench to verify the version, source, and expectedVersion. Initially retrieve Lumi.get_workbench_template. Retain projectId when continuing the same homepage.
2. Read project entry documentation and knowledge. Call Lumi.list_capabilities and tools/list to inspect the actual catalog and schemas.
3. Develop index.html, app.js, and style.css freely and add static assets as needed. Other frameworks must also output these three root files. Use public capabilities through window.lumi.tools.list/call, storage, theme, and toast.
4. Preserve projectId and SDK contracts. Submit manifest/files/sourceFiles JSON via Lumi.publish_workbench with the expectedVersion read before development. Retrieve and merge the latest source on conflict.
5. Return to Lumi to verify real behavior. State when a Runner is not implemented; do not simulate execution.
